text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Star Climax came to a close 
amidst immense excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The entire crowd cheers in celebration of 
the birth of the 'strongest' Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi also expressed her 
deepest gratitude once again, praising the 
Trainer as a key contributor to making the 
tournament happen!
